subject: k-class
notes: Builder general arrangement (private), IC16112 plan. The image is private and is not stored in Git. Sheet explicitly says NOT TO SCALE: longitudinal and transverse calibration use separate printed dimensions, and unprinted plan measurements are tentative. Heights are low-confidence simulator estimates because no K-class profile is supplied. All heights use waterline y=0; z=0 is half LOA. No safety-system details or drawing artwork are reproduced.

calibration.note: Independent x/y calibration from printed LOA and beam. Both checks are anchors, not independent evidence that this not-to-scale sheet preserves local geometry.

length_overall.note: Printed LOA excludes appendages; longitudinal calibration anchor.

length_waterline.note: Printed LWL transcribed directly; there is no profile to pick waterline endpoints independently.

beam.note: Printed beam excludes sponsons; transverse calibration anchor.

frame_spacing.note: Mean of 18 visible station intervals: picked frame 0 at x=99 and frame 18 at x=921; second point is the interpolated one-bay endpoint, not a new observed station. Not-to-scale plan.

frame_zero_z.note: Upper-deck frame 0 relative to hull-plan midpoint; not-to-scale plan.

wheelhouse_aft_z.note: Aft control-space enclosure wall on upper-deck plan, near frame 15.6; not-to-scale plan.

wheelhouse_fore_z.note: Forward curved enclosure wall on upper-deck plan, near frame 18.9; not-to-scale plan.

wheelhouse_width.note: Parallel enclosure side walls; not-to-scale plan.

demihull_width.note: Approximate port demihull width at frame 8 from hull plan. Not a measured waterline section; not-to-scale plan.

baseline_height.note: Estimated baseline from published 1.0 m hull draft; no K-class profile has been supplied.

waterline_height.note: Coordinate datum only; no K-class height is measured.

underwing_height.note: Unmeasured visual placeholder, 0.7 m below the estimated main deck. Needs K-class profile or crew measurement.

main_deck_height.note: Unmeasured assumption: published depth 3.5 m corresponds to main-deck elevation above baseline, less 1.0 m hull draft. Verify datum and deck camber.

upper_deck_height.note: Unmeasured K-class assumption: estimated main deck 2.5 m plus T-class 2.4 m deck rise. Needs K-class profile.

wheelhouse_roof_height.note: Unmeasured K-class assumption: estimated upper deck 4.9 m plus T-class 2.4 m roof rise. Needs K-class profile.
